share the blame: The whole team made the mistake together, so everyone should share the blame instead of pointing at one person.
整個團隊一起犯了錯，所以每個人都應該分擔責任，而不是指責某一個人。
share a view: My parents share a view on education: they both believe reading is more important than test scores.
我爸媽對教育持相同看法：他們都認為閱讀比考試成績更重要。
share the burden: Since our mother started working full-time, my brother and I share the burden of cooking and cleaning at home.
自從媽媽開始全職工作，我和哥哥就分擔在家煮飯和打掃的負擔。
share the cost: Four friends took a taxi to the airport and agreed to share the cost, so each paid only 200 dollars.
四個朋友搭計程車去機場，並同意分攤費用，所以每人只付了兩百元。
share a room: When we were young, my sister and I had to share a room because our apartment was very small.
我們小時候，因為公寓很小，我和姊姊必須同住一間房。
share one's feelings: It is healthy to share your feelings with friends you trust instead of keeping all your worries inside.
與你信任的朋友分享感受是健康的，而不是把所有煩惱都藏在心裡。
share the credit: The captain refused to take all the praise and insisted on sharing the credit with his teammates.
隊長拒絕獨攬所有讚美，堅持與隊友分享功勞。
shatter one's dreams: The serious knee injury shattered his dreams of becoming a professional basketball player.
嚴重的膝傷粉碎了他成為職業籃球員的夢想。
shatter the silence: The library was completely quiet until a phone rang loudly and shattered the silence.
圖書館原本一片安靜，直到一支手機大聲響起，打破了寂靜。
shatter confidence: Failing the driving test three times in a row can shatter confidence, so she decided to take more lessons first.
連續三次駕照考試沒過可能會摧毀信心，所以她決定先多上幾堂課。
shatter a record: The young swimmer hopes to shatter a record that has stood for twenty years at next month's games.
這位年輕泳將希望在下個月的運動會上大幅打破一項維持了二十年的紀錄。
shatter the glass: The baseball flew through the kitchen window and shattered the glass into hundreds of tiny pieces.
棒球飛進廚房窗戶，把玻璃打碎成數百片小碎片。
be shattered by the news: The whole family was completely shattered by the news of his sudden death and cried for days.
全家人被他猝逝的消息完全擊垮，哭了好幾天。
shave off seconds: With new shoes and better training, the runner hopes to shave off seconds from her personal best this year.
有了新鞋和更好的訓練，這位跑者希望今年能把個人最佳成績縮短幾秒。
shave prices: To attract more customers, the small shop decided to shave prices slightly during the holiday season.
為了吸引更多顧客，這家小店決定在假期期間小幅降價。
shave costs: The company tried to shave costs by turning off unused lights and printing on both sides of the paper.
公司試著透過關掉不用的燈和雙面列印來削減成本。
a close shave: A car almost hit me as I crossed the street without looking; it was a close shave.
我沒看路就過馬路，一輛車差點撞到我；真是死裡逃生。
shed light on: Scientists hope the newly found bones will shed light on how early humans lived thousands of years ago.
科學家希望新發現的骨頭能闡明數千年前早期人類如何生活。
shed tears: Many people in the audience shed tears during the sad ending of the movie.
電影悲傷的結局讓許多觀眾流下了眼淚。
shed jobs: Because sales fell sharply last year, the factory had to shed jobs and close two of its production lines.
因為去年銷售大幅下滑，工廠不得不裁員並關閉兩條生產線。
shed weight: After the doctor warned him about his health, he began jogging every morning to shed weight.
醫生警告他健康問題後，他開始每天早上慢跑來減重。
shed one's image: The singer hopes her new album will help her shed her image as a cute teen idol.
這位歌手希望她的新專輯能幫她擺脫可愛青少年偶像的形象。
shed blood: The two countries finally signed a peace agreement because neither side wanted to shed blood any longer.
兩國終於簽署和平協議，因為雙方都不想再流血了。
trees shed leaves: In autumn, many trees shed leaves, and the park paths are covered in red and yellow.
秋天時許多樹木落葉，公園的小路鋪滿了紅色和黃色。
shed skin: As a snake grows bigger, it must shed skin several times a year.
蛇長大時，一年必須蛻皮好幾次。
shelter from the rain: We forgot our umbrellas, so we had to shelter from the rain under a bridge for half an hour.
我們忘了帶傘，只好在橋下躲雨半小時。
shelter refugees: Several churches in the city opened their doors to shelter refugees who had escaped the war.
城裡幾間教會敞開大門，收容逃離戰爭的難民。
shelter from criticism: Her parents tried to shelter her from criticism, but she still read the mean comments online.
她的父母試著保護她免受批評，但她還是在網路上看到了那些惡意留言。
a sheltered life: Having grown up in a rich family, she had led a sheltered life and knew little about hardship.
她在富裕家庭長大，過著養尊處優的生活，對艱苦所知甚少。
take shelter: When the typhoon suddenly hit, the hikers had to take shelter in a small mountain cabin.
颱風突然來襲時，登山客只好在一間小山屋裡避難。
